title.narrative: Legal and Human Rights Centre. Strengthening Human Rights and Democratic Accountability in Tanzania
Legal and Human Rights Centre. Strengthening Human Rights and Democratic Accountability in Tanzania

description.narrative: Strengthening Human Rights and Democratic Accountability through Monitoring, Reporting, and Advocacy in Tanzania (“Sauti ya Haki”) project seeks to safeguard and promote human rights and democratic governance in Tanzania. In implementing this project, LHRC will collaborate with her grassroots actors known as human rights monitors, who have been recruited and currently operating in different parts of Mainland Tanzania. Amid growing concerns about civic space restrictions, violations of fundamental freedoms, and weakening accountability mechanisms, this project proposes a comprehensive approach to monitor, report, and respond to these challenges. Through a network of trained Friends of Haki (grassroot-level human rights monitors trained and maintained by LHRC), timely reporting, community engagement, and policy advocacy, the project seeks to inform public discourse, empower communities, and hold state and non-state actors accountable. The ultimate goal is to foster a transparent, inclusive, and rights-respecting democratic and equitable society, in line with LHRC’s mission. In this project, LHRC will promote democratic accountability and safeguard fundamental rights in Tanzania by enhancing a nationwide system for monitoring, documenting, and addressing human rights and good governance issues. The initiative resonates strongly with Finland’s development priorities, especially around inclusive governance and a rights-based society. LHRC will mobilize its national network of grassroot civic actors, Friends of Haki, to systematically capture and respond to human rights issues, including electoral injustices, restrictions on civic space, and abuse of public institutions. LHRC will respond from verified reports of Friends of Haki via Haki Kiganjani platform with advocacy, legal aid, strategic litigation, dialogue, media engagement, public reporting, community legal empowerment, and campaigns. Beneficiaries are victims of human rights violations, grassroot civic rights actors and all Tanzanians. Website: https://humanrights.or.tz/
